scripts.build: npm run build:web && vite build --config vite.worker.config.ts
scripts.build:web: tsc -b && node tooling/build/build-icons.mjs && vite build && node tooling/build/build-pwa.mjs && node tooling/build/build-compressed.mjs
scripts.build:native: tsc -b && node tooling/build/build-icons.mjs && vite build --mode native
scripts.native:sync: npm run build:native && cap sync && node tooling/build/build-native-icons.mjs
scripts.native:android: npm run native:sync && cap open android
scripts.native:ios: npm run native:sync && cap open ios
